mixer_type: Static mixer or T-mixer with gas-liquid contactor
mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Substrate, solvent, and additive dissolved before contacting catalyst and H2. Gas and liquid mixed immediately before entering the packed bed reactor to maximize interfacial area.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol and Acetic acid in Methanol to 0.1 M concentration.
Purge system with Hydrogen to remove Oxygen (incompatible pair).
post_reactor_steps: Filter out Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst using a frit or filter holder.
chemistry_notes: Heterogeneous hydrogenation using Pd(OH)2/Al2O3. Batch yield was low (38.1%) likely due to mass transfer limitations. Flow setup uses a packed bed reactor to immobilize catalyst, improving contact and allowing continuous operation. Acetic acid included to enhance rate. BPR required to maintain H2 solubility at 60°C. No light source used.

reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Packed bed reactor is necessary for heterogeneous catalyst Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 to prevent clogging and allow continuous flow. Analogies used coil reactors for homogeneous/photochemical reactions.
